description: NaVO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.32 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.84 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.68 Å) and two longer (1.83 Å) V-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent V atoms.
